summary: David knew that Yahweh was bigger than any giant, no matter how scary things looked.

story_reel.narration: David went to King Saul and said, 'Don't let anyone lose heart because of this giant. I will go and fight him.' Saul said, 'You can't! You're only a boy, and he has been a warrior since he was young.' But David answered, 'I take care of my father's sheep. When a lion or a bear came and took a lamb, I went after it and rescued the lamb. Yahweh rescued me from the lion and the bear, and He will rescue me from this Philistine.' So Saul said, 'Go, and Yahweh be with you.' Saul tried to give David his own armor and helmet, but they were too big and heavy. David couldn't even walk! So he took them off. He picked up his shepherd's staff, chose five smooth stones from the stream, put them in his shepherd's bag, and walked toward Goliath with his sling. Goliath laughed at him. But David said, 'You come to me with a sword and a spear, but I come to you in the name of Yahweh of Armies, the God you have insulted. Everyone will know that the battle is Yahweh's!' David ran toward the giant, put a stone in his sling, and swung it. The stone struck Goliath on the forehead, and the giant fell facedown to the ground.

identity_focus.core_truth: Yahweh makes me brave when I face big challenges.
identity_focus.reflection_prompt: What is one 'giant' challenge you face right now, and how can Yahweh help you face it?

quiz.question: Why wasn't David afraid of Goliath?
quiz.explanation: David said he came 'in the name of Yahweh.' His courage came from trusting God.

quiz.question: What did David do with King Saul's armor?
options: He gave it to his brothers
He took it off because he wasn't used to it
quiz.explanation: David couldn't walk in Saul's armor, so he took it off and went as himself, the way God made him.

quiz.question: How many smooth stones did David pick from the brook?
quiz.explanation: David chose five smooth stones and put them in his shepherd's bag.

micro_prayer.text: Yahweh, some things in my life feel as big as a giant. Thank You that You are bigger. Help me trust You and be brave like David. The battle is Yours. Amen.

companion.message: I was just a shepherd boy, but I knew who was on my side. You don't need someone else's armor. Yahweh made you just right for the challenge in front of you.

review.notes: Original spec sample, rewritten to fit Region 6 (first quiz question kept word for word). Goliath's death and beheading (17:50-51) are omitted; the giant 'fell facedown.' The lion and bear are told as rescuing a lamb. Confirm.
